text:
Maya: Kickoff reminder — NorthLyft reserved pool priming tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need confirmed daily token quota and final autoscale policy. Who owns load-test ops?
Jonas: I can own load-tests. What p95 target and daily token cap should i use to size instances?
Priya: From enablement: recommended autoscale min=3 max=36 step=3 cooldown=90s. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-onboard. Is that the one we ship?
Maya: yes, but finance carved out a month-1 hard cap of 4.5M tokens/day. We must ensure throttles and customer messaging.
Liam: plan: soft-throttle at 80% burn (warning header + email alert), hard throttle at 100% -> 429 + upgrade link. Also enable prefix KV caching for common prompts to cut token churn.
Jonas: i'll prepare three load profiles: steady 120 rps, short spike 700 rps x 8m, and a long soak 30 rps x 4h. will run each with kv-cache ON/OFF to show savings.
Priya: Legal asked for KMS ARN and priming waiver signed. Infra is providing KMS; legal needs to sign off before we run warmup tokens.
ops-bot: ReservedPool request: northlyft-rp-2026-07-01 status=provisioning. @Jonas to begin priming after pool ACTIVE.
Jonas: Warmup plan:
```
# quick warmup
./primetool --pool northlyft-rp-2026-07-01 --tokens 200000 --kv-cache on --profile warmup
```
I'll run canary traffic then escalate to full load if smoke passes.
Maya: timeline? Customer asked for handoff by 13:00 PT.
Jonas: estimate: warmup 20m, canary+smoke 20m, full load 80m, buffer 40m -> ~2h40m.
Liam: Rollback criteria: if p95 > 750ms for 5m OR error rate > 1.5% -> pause and route 15% traffic to fallback model, alert #eng-runtime and #customer-success.
Maya: i'll draft customer note and renewal-risk flag. If we hit month-1 cap we mark renewal risk and propose commit increase.
Priya: capturing enablement feedback: KMS checklist clarity, sample priming allowances, and a templated handoff note. I'll update the runbook post-tests.
Jonas: i'll post live metrics in this thread during the tests (p95, token burn, errors). :rocket:
Maya: thanks — if legal hasn't acknowledged KMS + waiver by EOD we'll postpone warmup. Otherwise proceed as scheduled.
